mathewortiz97@gmail.com.title: Getting Started with AI Employees
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.excerpt: Learn how to deploy, configure, and run your first AI employee in under 10 minutes.
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.content: Simpler Life 100 AI employees are pre-trained agents that plug into your existing tools. To get started: 1) Browse the marketplace and select an agent matching your needs. 2) Click 'Deploy' — the agent auto-provisions with default settings. 3) Connect the integrations it needs (CRM, ERP, email). 4) Configure any industry-specific rules. 5) Click 'Run' and monitor from the dashboard. Each agent comes with a 7-day trial.

mathewortiz97@gmail.com.title: Connecting Salesforce — OAuth Setup Guide
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.excerpt: Step-by-step guide to connecting Salesforce via OAuth 2.0 with the required scopes.
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.content: To connect Salesforce: 1) Navigate to Portal → CRM → Salesforce. 2) Click 'OAuth' to begin the authorization flow. 3) Log into your Salesforce org when redirected. 4) Approve the requested scopes (contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities). 5) You'll be redirected back — the connection will show as 'Connected'. Required scopes: api, refresh_token, offline_access. Ensure your Salesforce admin has enabled API access for your user profile.

mathewortiz97@gmail.com.title: Understanding CRM & ERP Connection Slots
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.excerpt: How connection slots work for CRM and ERP integrations, and how to upgrade.
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.content: CRM and ERP connections use a slot-based system. Each Connection Pack purchased from the Marketplace grants a set number of slots. Base plans include 2 CRM slots and 1 ERP slot. When all slots are used, you cannot connect additional CRM/ERP providers until you either disconnect an existing one or purchase more slots. To check slot usage: Portal → Connected Accounts. To upgrade: Portal → Marketplace → Connection Packs.

mathewortiz97@gmail.com.title: Invoice Processor — Configuration & Rules
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.excerpt: Configure extraction rules, approval thresholds, and GL coding for the Invoice Processor agent.
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.content: The Invoice Processor agent extracts data from uploaded invoices using OCR and AI. Configuration options: 1) PO Matching — enable automatic matching against purchase orders in your ERP. Tolerance: ±5% by default. 2) GL Coding — define rules for automatic general ledger account assignment based on vendor, department, or amount. 3) Approval Routing — set thresholds: <$1,000 auto-approve, $1,000-$10,000 manager approval, >$10,000 director approval. 4) Currency handling — multi-currency support with automatic conversion.

mathewortiz97@gmail.com.title: Troubleshooting: Agent Shows 'Error' Status
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.excerpt: Common causes and fixes when an AI employee shows an error state after deployment.
mathewortiz97@gmail.com.content: If your agent shows an 'Error' status: 1) Check connected integrations — verify all required connections are active. Navigate to Connected Accounts and look for any connections with errors. 2) Review recent activity logs in the dashboard for specific error messages. 3) Verify API credentials haven't expired — some providers require token refresh. 4) Check rate limits — some providers throttle API calls. 5) Ensure the agent has the correct permissions/scopes in the connected platform. For persistent issues, pause the agent, disconnect/reconnect the affected integration, then resume.
